pacman::p_load(tidyverse,urca,tseries,plotly,lubridate,knitr)
dataset <- readRDS("data/station_data.rds")
# filter data by input
filter_data <- function(data, station, date_range) {
  data %>%
    filter(station == station, date >= date_range[1], date <= date_range[2])
}
# convert data to ts
convert_to_ts <- function(data, var, start_date, frequency = 365) {
  ts(data[[var]], start = c(year(start_date), month(start_date)), frequency = frequency)
}
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Load dataset 
dataset <- readRDS("data/station_data.rds")

# Convert date columns
dataset$date <- as.Date(with(dataset, paste(year, month, day, sep="-")), "%Y-%m-%d")

# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Interactive Cross-Correlation Function (CCF) Analysis"),
    
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
            selectInput("station", "Select Station:", choices = unique(dataset$station)),
            selectInput("var1", "Select First Variable:", choices = colnames(dataset)[6:12]),
            selectInput("var2", "Select Second Variable:", choices = colnames(dataset)[6:12]),
            dateRangeInput("date_range", "Select Date Range:", 
                           start = min(dataset$date), end = max(dataset$date)),
            checkboxInput("apply_diff", "Apply Differencing", value = FALSE),
            sliderInput("lag_max", "Max Lag:", min = 1, max = 60, value = 30),
            actionButton("run_ccf", "Run CCF")
        ),
        
        mainPanel(
            plotOutput("ccfPlot")
        )
    )
)

# Define Server
server <- function(input, output) {
    
    observeEvent(input$run_ccf, {
        # Filter data
        data_filtered <- dataset %>%
            filter(station == input$station, date >= input$date_range[1], date <= input$date_range[2])
        
        # Convert selected columns to numeric time series
        ts1 <- ts(data_filtered[[input$var1]], start = c(year(min(data_filtered$date)), 
                                                          month(min(data_filtered$date))), frequency = 365)
        ts2 <- ts(data_filtered[[input$var2]], start = c(year(min(data_filtered$date)), 
                                                          month(min(data_filtered$date))), frequency = 365)
        
        # Apply differencing if checked
        if (input$apply_diff) {
            ts1 <- diff(ts1, differences = 1)
            ts2 <- diff(ts2, differences = 1)
        }
        
        # Compute CCF
        ccf_result <- ccf(ts1, ts2, lag.max = input$lag_max, plot = FALSE)
        
        # Create CCF plot
        output$ccfPlot <- renderPlot({
            df_ccf <- data.frame(lag = ccf_result$lag, acf = ccf_result$acf)
            
            ggplot(df_ccf, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
                geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
                geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1.96 / sqrt(nrow(df_ccf)), 1.96 / sqrt(nrow(df_ccf))),
                           linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
                theme_minimal() +
                labs(title = "Cross-Correlation Function", x = "Lag", y = "Correlation")
        })
    })
}

# Run App
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
